framework.summary: Large frontier developers must write, follow and publish a public safety plan, and a child protection plan if they run a covered chatbot.
framework.quote: shall write, implement, comply with, and clearly and conspicuously publish on the large frontier developer's internet website a public safety plan

transparency_report.summary: Before deploying a new or substantially modified frontier model, a large frontier developer must publish summaries of its risk assessments.
transparency_report.quote: A large frontier developer shall conspicuously publish on the large frontier developer's website summaries of the following before deploying a new frontier model

incident_reporting.summary: Large frontier developers must report a safety incident to the Office of Artificial Intelligence Policy within 15 days of discovery.
incident_reporting.quote: A large frontier developer shall report a safety incident to the office within 15 days after the day on which the large frontier developer discovers the incident.

imminent_risk_reporting.summary: A critical incident posing imminent risk of death or serious physical injury must be disclosed to law enforcement or a public safety agency within 24 hours.
imminent_risk_reporting.quote: imminent risk of death or serious physical injury, shall disclose that incident within 24

third_party_audit.summary: The plan must describe how the developer uses third parties to assess catastrophic risk; no independent audit is required.
third_party_audit.quote: uses third parties to assess the potential for catastrophic risks and the effectiveness of mitigations of catastrophic risks

whistleblower.summary: Frontier developers may not take adverse action against employees who report safety threats or violations; employees may sue.
whistleblower.quote: A frontier developer may not take adverse action against an employee because of a lawful act of the employee

registration.summary: The bill sets no registration or licensing requirement.

shutdown.summary: The bill requires no shutdown or kill-switch capability.

compute_threshold.summary: A frontier developer has used at least 10^26 integer or floating-point operations to train a frontier model, including fine-tuning.
compute_threshold.quote: a quantity of computing power of at least 10^26 integer or floating-point operations to train a frontier model

revenue_threshold.summary: A large frontier developer, with affiliates, had annual revenue of at least $500,000,000 in the preceding calendar year.
revenue_threshold.quote: had annual revenue of at least $500,000,000 in the preceding calendar year

harm_threshold.summary: Catastrophic loss means death or serious bodily injury of more than 50 individuals, or property damage over $1,000,000,000.
harm_threshold.quote: the death or serious bodily injury of more than 50 individuals

penalties.summary: Civil penalty up to $1,000,000 for a first violation and $3,000,000 for each later one, sued for by the attorney general.
penalties.quote: A large frontier developer that violates this part is subject to a civil penalty that does not

effective_date.summary: The bill takes effect on May 6, 2026.
effective_date.quote: This bill takes effect on May 6, 2026.

notes: Text is the 1st Substitute (Buff) of HB 286, not necessarily the latest version.
